output.markdownRules:
Literal cells: line breaks become
; HTML and Markdown syntax are escaped. JSON requires an array of objects: columns follow first-seen keys (object key order), missing/null cells are blank, nested values use compact JSON. Empty and whitespace keys are preserved. Extra CSV fields receive generated column names.
error.jsonObjects: JSON input must be an array containing only objects (no single object, primitive, nested-array, or null rows).
statistics.title: Selected column statistics
statistics.counts: Numeric {valid} · Empty {empty} · Invalid {invalid} · Out of range {range}
statistics.pendingFull: Complete full processing before statistics are available.
statistics.notInResult: Selected columns are not in the current result.
statistics.rules: Statistics cover complete result rows after filters and transforms, not the preview. Empty/whitespace cells are excluded, never treated as zero. Decimal/scientific numbers only; maximum 100 significant digits, exponent magnitude ≤1000, and 512 characters. Invalid and out-of-range values are excluded from sum/mean. Sum is exact; mean uses up to 20 significant digits, rounding halves up (≈ marks rounding). Distinct counts nonempty original cell strings, case- and whitespace-sensitive; 1 and 1.0 differ. Missing/null JSON cells are empty.
statistics.failed: Could not calculate statistics. Reselect a column to retry.
